page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1-c10d1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type includes 3126 GB of local SSD storage bundled directly with the instance. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and it does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high capacity of bundled local SSD storage relative to the compute and memory profile, this instance is designed for storage-intensive workloads. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and substantial local SSD capacity makes it appropriate for database hosting, data warehousing, and localized transactional processing where low-latency storage access is required.
